lineage: Two spatial parts of the same1998 EM300 survey; not independent. Current USGS Monterey nearshore product also names1998 acquisitions but states separate MBARI5m grid was not merged; neither use cross-product agreement as independent evidence nor invent disjoint underlying soundings. Existing finest-source selection handles overlap.
